projects.name: CDOT Ten Year Plan Project Lines (approved)
projects.notes: CDOT 10-Year Plan strategic pipeline projects as lines (ArcGIS Online item updated 2026-09, owner Planning_GIS_CDOT). planningprojectidstatus is the phase (see status_values); anything before construction is planned/in development. No cost or letting date in this layer. stip_id links to the STIP; projecttype is a second category field; route + milepoststart/milepostend locate it; adaptiveformtablewebsite is the project web page.

projects.name: CDOT Ten Year Plan Project Points (approved)
projects.notes: Point version of the 10-Year Plan projects (17 records). Field names differ from the line layer: projectname, projectdescription, projectstatus, stipid.

projects_note: CDOT's own open-data server (dtdapps.codot.gov/server/rest/services/Webapps/open_data_sde/FeatureServer, layers 24 'Projects (all types) - Line' and 25 '- Point', listed on ArcGIS Online as updated 2026) could NOT be reached on 2026-11-16/17: connection timed out on every attempt (old host dtdapps.coloradodot.info gave HTTP 522). Not verified, so not recorded as a source; worth retrying because it probably carries all project types with cost and dates.

parcels_statewide.name: Colorado Public Parcels - Colorado_Public_Parcel_Composite (Governor's Office of Information Technology)
parcels_statewide.restrictions: No commercial-use or solicitation restriction stated. Licence text is a warranty disclaimer only (data used at one's own risk; State of Colorado makes no warranty of accuracy or completeness).
parcels_statewide.notes: Statewide composite collected annually from counties in one schema (dateReceived shows when each county's data arrived, e.g. 4/23/2026). owner2 = second owner; account = assessor account; apprValTot/asedValTot/salePrice are stored as text; saleDate text; landUseDsc, zoningDesc, legalDesc also present. The 'sharing' field is 'Public' in the sample; counties that do not share publicly may be missing or have blank owner fields, so check coverage by countyName.
parcels_statewide.approved_note: Approved by the account owner on 2026-11-17: no restriction on commercial use stated.

summary: Statewide parcels with owner and mailing address verified (2.6M records). Projects: CDOT 10-Year Plan lines/points verified (phase and type, no cost or dates); CDOT's fuller 'Projects (all types)' server was unreachable and is unverified.
